evidence.text: The bowl had leaned in the kiln.
Elias had come to repair a temperature sensor that the workshop could replace in less than three minutes.
If you decline, palliative and emergency care remain guaranteed. Advanced replacement will not.
A small projection formed above it: Elias at perhaps fifty-two, black hair cut short, shoulders broader, no tremor.
The younger Elias used his hands as he spoke, the right thumb rubbing the side of the forefinger. The biological Elias did the same thing beside her.

scope: New source-specific early scenes; ending chapters read to protect revelations.
